title: The Signal of Sector Nine
author: Lior Nystrom
blurb: Oscar Iversen, a pilot bonded to an AI that lies, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
